taxonomy.note: Older field guides and nursery sources may still use the former genus Gaura; preserve those names as synonyms but use current Oenothera placement canonically.

evidence: Kew/POWO gives the native range as southeastern Texas to southwestern Louisiana, not Central Texas.
Texas Wildbuds explicitly notes that its Austin/Travis Wildflower Center images are outside the native range and that the species is mainly native in southeastern Texas and southwestern Louisiana.
The project source pool has Hays wild observations, but those are not counted as native-range evidence because the species is widely cultivated and can persist/escape outside its native range.
target_zone_range.blocking_issue: No project-target county has yet been established as a native county to the project standard. Resolve with BONAP/NAPA county-level native distribution before treating it as a target-zone native.
target_zone_range.guardrail: Do not count cultivated Austin/Travis material or project Hays observations as native-range proof until county-native evidence is established.

morphology.look_here_first: Recognize the tall airy perennial first: wiry arching flowering stems carry white-to-pink four-petaled flowers with the petals held mostly toward the upper side and long exserted stamens hanging/projecting below.
diagnostic_traits: perennial clump from a stout rootstock
four petals oriented mainly to one side/upward side of the flower
flowers in an airy elongate spike/raceme

confusers.separator: Both have the old 'gaura' look, but O. lindheimeri is a perennial clumping plant with larger airy flowers and strongly one-sided petal presentation; O. suffulta is an annual with a more compact spike, radial white flowers, crimson anthers, and chunky 4-lobed nutlike fruit.
O. curtiflora is an annual velveteen plant with extremely tiny flowers (~3 mm across); O. lindheimeri has conspicuous showy flowers and a tall airy perennial habit.

installation_guardrail: Do not install as a target-zone native until Calvin explicitly approves an exception or the range hold is resolved.
